mapper.select: select * from t_erp_fin_account t where t.shopid=#{shopid,jdbcType=CHAR}

select t.*,m.name paymethName from t_erp_fin_account t left join t_erp_purchase_form_payment_method m on m.id=t.paymeth LEFT JOIN t_erp_purchase_form_payment_method_index i ON m.id=i.method_id AND i.shopid=#{shopid,jdbcType=CHAR} where t.shopid=#{shopid,jdbcType=CHAR} and t.isdelete=0 order by IFNULL(i.findex,t.paymeth) asc, t.findex asc, t.isdefault desc

select t.*,m.name paymethName from t_erp_fin_account t left join t_erp_purchase_form_payment_method m on m.id=t.paymeth where t.shopid=#{shopid,jdbcType=CHAR} and t.isdelete=1 order by t.paymeth asc,t.isdefault desc
